claims.claim_vi: The source names five areas: Language, Layout, Time zone, Currency, Company entity and accounting, with the listed advice (separate texts, no string concatenation, complete sentences, reserve space, store UTC and display local time, define display and settlement currencies, foreign exchange service, multiple bookkeeping methods and treasury management).

claims.claim_vi: Own experiment, 2026-10-19, Python 3 with Babel 2.18.0 (CLDR data) and zoneinfo: 1234567.891 formats as 1,234,567.891 in en_US and 1.234.567,891 in vi_VN and de_DE; 2026-03-08 short date is 3/8/26, 8/3/26, 2026/03/08, 08.03.26 for en_US, vi_VN, ja_JP, de_DE; 1234.5 VND formats as 1.234 ₫ in vi_VN; plural categories besides 'other': en 1, vi 0, ja 0, ru 3, ar 5; 06:30 UTC on 2026-03-08 is 13:30 +07:00 Hanoi, 15:30 +09:00 Tokyo, 01:30 -05:00 New York; New York local clock goes from 01:59 -05:00 to 03:01 -04:00 across two real minutes; Hanoi stays +07:00 in January and July.
